title: Mathematics
subtitle: Textbook for Class IX
_finish: None, deliberately. This carried "finish": "night" and rendered arc's palette anyway: a direction sets the same tokens a finish sets and comes later in cover.css, so it wins at equal specificity. Removing the line left the proof byte-identical, which is how that was confirmed rather than argued. Do not add one back expecting it to do anything — colour on a cover is the direction's, and if this volume wants a different palette it wants a different direction.
_spine: Spine width is normally bulk, not a design choice: pages / 2 x caliper, plus the two covers. 316pp of 80gsm bookwove at 0.106mm bulks to 16.7mm, and 0.5mm of board and case takes it to 17.2 (--book, 24 September 2026: four of front matter and 310 numbered, with Chapter 6 now NCERT’s Measuring Space). The printer’s 15mm below was quoted for the earlier, shorter extent and needs re-quoting. spineWidth overrides that arithmetic and is set to 15mm to the printer's specification, a bulkier stock than the caliper here describes. Keep pages and paperCaliper current anyway: cover.mjs prints the computed bulk beside the declared width, so a spine that has drifted from its stock is visible. Re-derive the count from --book before the cover goes to press and round up to a multiple of four.
